title: Hum Aapke Hain Kaun
desc: Prem and Nisha fall in love through family celebrations, but after tragedy, duty and family expectations challenge their chance at happiness.

title: Thalapathy Is The G.O.A.T.
desc: Gandhi, an undercover agent, faces turmoil after a tragic mission. Years later, he encounters a young man claiming to be his son, Jeevan. Secrets unravel as danger looms.

title: Vivah - Journey From Engagment To Marriage
desc: Poonam, an orphan, is engaged to Prem from a wealthy family. Just two days before the wedding, her house catches fire, leaving her with first-degree burns.

title: Ajay
desc: Manorama falls in love with Ajay, even though they come from different social backgrounds. They want to get married, but Manorama's uncles try their best to separate the happy couple.

title: Ghayal
desc: Ajay, wrongfully framed by Balwant Rai, teams up with fellow convicts for a thrilling quest for revenge. Together, they plot to reclaim his life and settle the score.

title: Ghayal Once Again
desc: Four teens accidentally film a murder involving a well-known figure and soon find themselves in danger. Ajay, a brave journalist, steps in to help them expose the killers.

title: Krishna (1996)
desc: Krishna, an aspiring pilot, is wrongly imprisoned for seven years. After his release, he secretly teams up with a powerful minister to seek justice and exact revenge.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: 3 A.M.
desc: Sunny, Raj and Cyrus attempt a ghost-hunting reality show at a haunted site, but their plan spirals into terror as real supernatural forces strike, leading to deadly consequences.

title: Teen Patti
desc: Mathematician Perci Trachtenberg meets Venkat, a genius whose probability theory pulls him into the dark, tempting world of gambling, where brilliance meets greed, risk, and unexpected consequences.

title: Vijay The Master
desc: An alcoholic professor starts teaching at a juvenile centre without knowing. He soon clashes with a gangster who uses the kids to do his dirty work.

title: Ek Rishtaa: The Bond of Love
desc: Ajay's relationship with his powerful businessman father is strained, but when he discovers his brother-in-law's malicious plans, he rises to protect his family.

title: Sam Bahadur
desc: Sam Manekshaw, one of India's most decorated army officers, served for over four decades, fought five wars, and became the first Indian officer to be promoted to Field Marshal.

title: Lal Salaam
desc: Talented aspiring cricketers, unfairly dropped from the game, battle rejection and setbacks. Refusing to quit, they push through obstacles with grit to reclaim their dreams.

title: KA
desc: Abhinaya Vasudev wakes up amnesiac in a high-security interrogation cell, where a mysterious interrogator uses hypnosis to uncover his past and expose a trail of roguish deeds.

title: Saudagar
desc: The friendship between Veeru and Rajeshwar turns into a bitter rivalry over time. Years later, they confront each other again when their grandchildren fall in love.
